# `passportsim plan_flash`

Plan what would be written to a real AI Passport, without opening it.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_plan_flash` | none | yes | yes | no |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim plan_flash <image> [--erase-nvs] [--port <PORT>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `erase_nvs` | `--erase-nvs` | `boolean` | no | CLI only, never over MCP: erase the `nvs` partition as well. |
| `image` | `<image>` | `string` | yes | A merged `.bin` of the whole 8 MB part. A build directory is refused in v1. |
| `port` | `--port <PORT>` | `string` \| `null` | no | A discovered 303A:1001 port; required when several are attached. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_HOST_UNSUPPORTED` (19), `E_PLAN_REFUSED` (5000). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Plan the official image without a device

```sh
passportsim plan_flash --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "image": "FoloToy-AI-Passport-8MB.bin"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "image": "FoloToy-AI-Passport-8MB.bin"
}
'@ | passportsim plan_flash --json -
```
